quality_review: Host checked original file identities, live read/write receipts, source resolution, frozen-guide attribution, current/historical hashes, failure preservation, and bounded next actions. The guide and its addendum are one delivery.

time.timing_scope: B14 has no saved launcher duration and is excluded from the measured sum, not treated as zero. Launcher wall intervals include the pre-call memory inventory and synchronous CLI invocation; not CPU time or pure model latency. Post-run collection and unrecorded coordinator work are excluded.

limitations: Failed turns remain failed, including B7/B8 step exhaustion and B10/B12 startup failures, B11 invalid paging and B13 loss of required tools, and B14 unverified result with missing launcher receipt
No autonomous wakeup or independent full self-repair claim; coordinator assistance was required
